name: Tracery
description: Bar tracery: a lobed outline with a smaller lobed outline set inside it.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: @shape(points: 240; r: abs(cos(2t))^0.6; scale: 0.98; frame: 10); clip-path: @shape(points: 240; r: abs(cos(2t))^0.6; scale: 0.98; frame: 10); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 28%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: @shape(points: 240; r: abs(cos(2t))^0.6; rotate: 45; frame: 16); clip-path: @shape(points: 240; r: abs(cos(2t))^0.6; rotate: 45; frame: 16); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
